title: Finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$: valuation ring, uniformizer and finite quotients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime number and let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a *finite extension*: a field $E$ with a fixed field homomorphism $\mathbf Q_\ell\to E$ making $E$ finite-dimensional as a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-vector space. The absolute value $|\cdot|_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ extends uniquely to an absolute value $|\cdot|_E$ on $E$, namely $|x|_E=|N_{E/\mathbf Q_\ell}(x)|_\ell^{1/[E:\mathbf Q_\ell]}$, and $E$ is complete for it. The *valuation ring* (ring of integers) of $E$ is

$$
\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:|x|_E\leq1\},
$$

the integral closure of $\mathbf Z_\ell$ in $E$; it is a discrete valuation ring, hence a local ring whose maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_E=\{x\in E:|x|_E<1\}$ is principal, with finite residue field $\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E$. A *uniformizer* of $E$ is an element $\varpi_E\in\mathcal O_E$ generating $\mathfrak m_E$, equivalently a nonzero element of $\mathfrak m_E$ of largest absolute value; every $x\in E^\times$ is uniquely $u\,\varpi_E^{m}$ with $u\in\mathcal O_E^\times$ and $m\in\mathbf Z$. For every integer $n\geq1$ the *finite coefficient ring* is the quotient ring

$$
A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E,
$$

a finite local ring, with the surjective transition homomorphisms $A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ induced by the identity of $\mathcal O_E$. The ring $A_{E,n}$ does not depend on the choice of $\varpi_E$, since any two uniformizers differ by a unit.

No document in literature/ proves the facts the definition rests on (unique extension of the absolute value, $\mathcal O_E$ a discrete valuation ring with finite residue field): Stacks Tag 0EXQ (More on Algebra, Section 15.111 Extensions of discrete valuation rings) defines extensions of discrete valuation rings but does not treat finite extensions of a complete field; the standard reference is Serre, Local Fields, Ch. II, §2, Proposition 3 and its corollaries (not obtained)

mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: the class states exactly the properties of O_E used here, but Mathlib does not know that a finite extension of ℚ_ℓ satisfies it
